en.title: [Department of Food and Nutrition] 2026 Fall Semester Lab Assistant (LA1) Recruitment Notice (~10/7)
summary: The Department of Food and Nutrition is recruiting 3 lab assistants (LA1) for the 2026 Fall semester
Eligibility: graduate students scheduled for regular enrollment (정규등록 예정), full-time students who are not full-scholarship recipients
Duties: assisting with classes/experiments in Nutritional Biochemistry Lab, Western Cooking Practice, and Nutritional Assessment and Lab courses
Required document: Department of Food and Nutrition TA application form (must specify the course applied for)
Submission deadline: by Wednesday, October 7, 2026, via email to foodnutrition@inha.ac.kr
Successful applicants will be notified individually
en.easyExplanation: The Department of Food and Nutrition is recruiting 3 lab assistants (LA1) for the 2026 Fall semester. Only graduate students scheduled for regular enrollment (정규등록 예정) who are full-time students not receiving a full scholarship may apply. Submit the application form by email by Wednesday, October 7, 2026.
